expected_structural_delta: Remove one dead GraphQL feature root; add one install-time migration notification and one successful-setup transition; keep the legacy runtime only for users who have not completed manual migration.
minimum_design: Keep the existing managed-backup REST service and Core-compatible job files, notify users with an active legacy backup, continue that backup until managed setup succeeds, then stop its watcher without deleting the old cloud backup.
outcome: The Connect page offers encrypted managed flash-backup setup, existing legacy backups continue until manual migration, and affected users receive a migration notification after installation.

reuse_decisions.name: ManagedBackupService and ManagedBackupStore
reuse_decisions.rationale: They already own provisioning, Restic execution, and the Core-compatible backup contract.

reuse_decisions.name: flashBackupActivated server-state field
reuse_decisions.rationale: Keep the existing Update OS consumer while changing its source from legacy flashbackup.ini to the managed Restic job.

reuse_decisions.name: Git/PHP flash backup runtime
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing users keep protection until the managed Restic setup succeeds; the runtime stops after that explicit migration point.
